name: HubSpot
summary: CRM and marketing, sales, service and content software with Breeze, the vendor's AI: Breeze Customer Agent, which resolves common support inquiries across channels without a person, and Breeze Prospecting Agent, which researches accounts, finds contacts and drafts personalized outreach for a rep to approve. For agents, the vendor publishes a remote HubSpot MCP server at mcp.hubspot.com with read-only access to CRM objects and engagements, authorized by OAuth through a user-level app on the developer platform; measured 401 with no credentials.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-11 23:45Z, no credentials: MCP initialize at mcp.hubspot.com answers 401 with a Bearer challenge naming its protected-resource metadata. Vendor: OAuth 2.0 through a user-level app with read scopes on the new developer platform; an account admin connects first. Read-only access.

jobs.summary: Breeze Prospecting Agent, the vendor's words on this page: it uses "CRM data and real-time signals to craft personalized outreach"; "Reps review the agent's research and drafted outreach, then approve before anything sends." Metered per lead; edition not established. Not measured.

Breeze Customer Agent, the vendor's words on this page: "resolves common support inquiries automatically across channels, 24 hours a day, resolving up to 70% of conversations without human intervention"; hands off "when human judgment is needed". Professional and up, $0.50 each. Not measured.
